"import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc
import json

def build_turbojet(t4_target):
    prob = om.Problem()
    prob.model = om.Group()

    prob.model.add_subsystem('flow', pyc.FlowStation())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightConditions())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.LMAPData))
    prob.model.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft())
    prob.model.add_subsystem('perf', pyc.Performance())

    prob.model.connect('flow.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('noz.Fl_O', 'perf.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('fc.FlightConditions', 'flow.Fl_I')
    prob.model.connect('inlet.Fl_O:tot:P', 'perf.Pt2')
    prob.model.connect('comp.Fl_O:tot:P', 'perf.Pt3')
    prob.model.connect('burner.Fl_O:tot:P', 'perf.Pt4')
    prob.model.connect('turb.Fl_O:tot:P', 'perf.Pt5')
    prob.model.connect('comp.power', 'shaft.power_in')
    prob.model.connect('turb.power', 'shaft.power_out')
    prob.model.connect('inlet.Fl_O:stat:W', 'perf.w_in')
    prob.model.connect('noz.Fl_O:stat:W', 'perf.w_out')
    prob.model.connect('perf.Fn', 'fc.Fn')

    prob.model.set_input_defaults('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('fc.MN', 0.8)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('inlet.ram_recovery', 1.0)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.map.Tt', 518.0, units='degR')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.map.Pt', 14.696, units='psi')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.map.W', 100.0, units='lbm/s')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.map.Nmech', 8000.0, units='rpm')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.polytropic.eff', 0.9)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('comp.mech_eff', 1.0)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('burner.dPqP', 0.05)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('burner.Tt', t4_target, units='degR')
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('turb.eff', 0.9)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('turb.mech_eff', 1.0)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults('noz.Cv', 1.0)

    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('flow.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('noz.Fl_O', 'perf.Fl_I')
    prob.model.pyc_connect_flow('fc.Fl_O', 'flow.Fl_I')

    prob.setup(check=False)
    prob.set_val('fc.Fn', 1000.0, units='lbf')
    prob.set_solver_print(level=-1)
    prob.run_model()
    return prob
